response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(`T-BIL` / NULLIF(CRE, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1985-04-22' AND '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM g) SELECT g.CENTROMEA, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio / m.overall_mean AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.overall_mean IS NOT NULL;
